content.text:
**Finding: missing (high severity) — no Customer termination-for-convenience right.**

- Section 9 contains only for-cause (9.1), insolvency (9.2) and Vendor-default/security (9.3) termination rights; there is no 9.4, and Sections 8, 10.2, 11 and 27.3 contain no no-fault exit. Text searches for "convenience" and "without cause" confirm the gap.
- The Agreement runs three years (8.1) with Order Forms auto-renewing on 180 days' notice (8.2), so the absence of any convenience exit is below the fallback and in walk-away territory.
- Vendor has no convenience right either, so no Vendor-side deletion is needed.
- Redline validated (ok:true): new Section 9.4 at the preferred position — 30 days' written notice, pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, no early-termination penalty, and no Vendor mid-term convenience right — with 60 days' notice offered as a fallback in the comment.
